description_en: Lists Database and Table assets associated with a specific Tag in a DataAgent Workspace
description_zh: 获取DataAgent协作空间数据中心添加库表信息
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-tag-meta-asset --tag-name sys::DMS-DA::cn-hangzhou::space:abcde --meta-type META_DATABASE --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagMetaAsset

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

You can find the tenant ID by hovering the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management Service (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the tag. To retrieve database and table assets from a DataAgent Workspace, specify the tag name in the format `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.help_zh: 标签名字，需要获取DataAgent协作空间下的库表信息，传递格式为 `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en:
Specify `META_DATABASE` to retrieve databases.

Specify `META_TABLE` to retrieve tables in a specific database
parameters.help_zh:
获取库列表，传递为 META_DATABASE
当获取某个库详情的表列表，传递为 META_TABLE
parameters.name: meta_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent asset.

Omit this parameter to retrieve databases.

To retrieve tables in a specific database, set this parameter to the `dbId` of the database
parameters.help_zh:
资产对应的父级MetaId：
当获取DataAgent数据中心左侧库列表，此值无需传递
当获取某个库详情的表列表，此值传递为 对应的 dbId
parameters.name: meta_parent_id

parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

MetaEntityAttrs.description_en:
If `MetaType` is `META_DATABASE`, this object contains the following fields:

`schemaName`: The name of the database. For PostgreSQL-compatible databases, this field indicates the schema name.

`catalogName`: The name of the catalog. This field applies only to PostgreSQL-compatible databases.

`dbId`: The ID of the database in Data Management Service (DMS).

`instanceResourceId`: The resource ID of the instance. If the database is in an ApsaraDB RDS instance, this field indicates the ID of the RDS instance.

`dbType`: The type of the database in DMS.

If `MetaType` is `META_TABLE`, this object contains the following fields:

`schemaName`: The name of the database containing the table. For PostgreSQL-compatible databases, this field indicates the schema name.

`catalogName`: The name of the catalog. This field applies only to PostgreSQL-compatible databases.

`dbId`: The ID of the database in DMS.

`dbType`: The type of the database in DMS.

`tableName`: The name of the table.

`tableSchemaName`: The name of the table schema. This field is valid only for SQL Server
MetaEntityAttrs.description_zh:
MetaType=META_DATABASE时包含如下信息：
schemaName：库名，PG系为schema名
catalogName：PG系为库名
dbId：DMS dbId
instanceResourceId：实例资源id，如果是RDS，此值为RDS实例id
dbType：DMS dbType

MetaType=META_TABLE时包含如下信息：
schemaName：库名，PG系为schema名
catalogName：PG系为库名
dbId：DMS dbId
dbType：DMS dbType
tableName：表名
tableSchemaName：表架构名，SQLServer下才有效

MetaType.description_en:
`META_DATABASE`: The asset is a database.

`META_TABLE`: The asset is a table
